title: Moroccan Mint Tea
description: Gunpowder green tea brewed with a fistful of fresh spearmint and plenty of sugar, poured from a height into small glasses.
notes: Adjust the sugar down if you like, but in Morocco it is sweet.

steps.text: Rinse the gunpowder green tea in the pot with a little of the boiling water, swirl, and pour it away.
steps.tip: The rinse takes the harsh edge off. Moroccans call it washing the tea.

steps.text: Add the spearmint and sugar, fill with the rest of the water, and simmer.
Pour a glass from a height and return it to the pot two or three times to mix.
steps.tip: Pouring from high aerates the tea and raises the foam that marks a good glass.

steps.text: Serve in small glasses, poured from as high as you dare.
